title: Background, deployment, and architecture — concept map
intro: This module covers production-grade patterns for ASP.NET Core Web APIs: long-running BackgroundService workers with scoped DbContext via IServiceScopeFactory, in-process Channels and Amazon SQS queues, the transactional outbox pattern for reliable messaging, WebApplicationFactory integration tests, Docker multi-stage deployment with Kubernetes health probes, Clean Architecture layering, and gRPC versus REST tradeoffs for internal versus public APIs.

  BG[BackgroundService\nOutboxDispatcher] -->|poll outbox| DB
  BG -->|IServiceScopeFactory per batch| Scope[Scoped DbContext]
  BG -->|SendMessage| SQS

  Test[WebApplicationFactory] -->|TestServer| API
  Docker[Docker multi-stage] --> K8s[Kubernetes\nliveness + readiness]

  Public[Public clients] -->|REST JSON| API

conceptCards.title: IHostedService / BackgroundService
conceptCards.summary: Long-running workers co-hosted with API. Singleton — inject IServiceScopeFactory not DbContext. stoppingToken for graceful shutdown.

conceptCards.title: Channels and SQS
conceptCards.summary: Channel<T> for in-process async queues with backpressure. SQS for durable at-least-once cross-service messaging. Idempotent consumers required.

conceptCards.title: Outbox pattern
conceptCards.summary: Domain + outbox row in one DB transaction. Dispatcher publishes to SQS. Solves dual-write. Duplicates ok, lost events not.

conceptCards.title: Integration testing
conceptCards.summary: WebApplicationFactory boots real pipeline in TestServer. ConfigureTestServices for fakes. Testcontainers for real PostgreSQL.
conceptCards.example: factory.CreateClient() + assert outbox row in DB

conceptCards.title: Docker deployment
conceptCards.summary: Multi-stage: SDK build, aspnet runtime. /health/live vs /health/ready. K8s probes. Graceful shutdown for workers.

conceptCards.title: Clean Architecture
conceptCards.summary: Domain → Application → Infrastructure → Presentation. Dependency rule: inward only. MediatR handlers + port interfaces.
conceptCards.example: IOrderRepository in Application, EfOrderRepository in Infrastructure

conceptCards.title: gRPC vs REST
conceptCards.summary: REST JSON public and browser. gRPC protobuf internal HTTP/2. BFF hybrid. Shared Application layer behind both.
